expected.message: Git could not finish the target commit. Its previous staging selection was restored; the task commit is retained. Inspect the target checkout in Changes and fix its Git identity or commit hooks, then commit the retained changes there and refresh the task. Do not repeat Merge while the target has uncommitted changes.

steps.content:
#!/bin/sh
head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
tree=$(git rev-parse "HEAD^{tree}")
next=$(printf "Hook commit\n" | git commit-tree "$tree" -p "$head") || exit 2
git update-ref HEAD "$next" "$head" || exit 3
exit 1
